senses.gloss: (I)--a son of ब्रह्मा, who remained a celibate. भा. IV. 8. 1.

(II)--the eldest son of नहुष who did not like to be king and who devoted himself to the realisation of आत्मन्; became a वैखानस yogi even as a boy;
1: भा. IX. १८. 1-2; M. २४. ५०; Vi. IV. १०. 1-2.
married गा, daughter of काकुस्थ.
2: Br. III. ६८. १२; वा. ९३. १३-14.
--a daughter of Bhaya and मृत्यु. भा. IV. 8. 4.
--the father of जन्तुधान; had ten sons, all राक्षसस्, and followers of the शुन् god. Br. III. 7. ८६-90; 8. ६१; वा. ६९. १२८; ७५. ४५.
